# Legacy METS fixture

`production-aip-mets-file.xml` is copied unchanged from
[mets-reader-writer] at revision `0affd1133b3fee11c1ee911eb445ba8504c9be1c`.
Its introducing commit, [1a1fcc93], describes it as generated by an
Archivematica QA deployment. The document identifies Archivematica 1.6 and
uses PREMIS 2.2. Its original file, `abc.txt`, has size and format metadata
but no `dateCreatedByApplication`.

The upstream suite uses this fixture for METS XMLSchema and Archivematica
Schematron validation. AIPscan's import tests vary only the original file's
optional creation date in memory; the fixture on disk remains unchanged.

AIP name tests also use this fixture to recover the package name from the
physical structure map when no PREMIS package name is available. They vary
the root directory label in memory to exercise UUID suffix handling.

[mets-reader-writer]: https://github.com/artefactual-labs/mets-reader-writer/blob/0affd1133b3fee11c1ee911eb445ba8504c9be1c/fixtures/production-aip-mets-file.xml
[1a1fcc93]: https://github.com/artefactual-labs/mets-reader-writer/commit/1a1fcc93e73237e1a7c252b416dc4b6e443e9185
